_comment: Seed for the chat-model context table. Keys are FULL model ids, never family wildcards: glm-5.2 has a 1M window while glm-5.1 has 200K, so a 'glm-5*' pattern would misreport by 5x. Every row cites the official vendor page it was read from; a row without a citation is a test failure, not a data choice (tests/test_model_router_context_table.py). Claude-family ids are deliberately absent — Claude Code knows their windows natively. Window/output figures are the vendor's own decimal-K figures, not powers of two. This file is the FALLBACK: the launcher exports a user-editable table to <vct_root>/model-gateway/chat_model_context.json, and that export wins when present.

glm-4.5-air.source_note: This model has no page of its own (https://docs.z.ai/guides/llm/glm-4.5-air returns 404); its specification sits on the GLM-4.5 card, which is what the cited URL is. Third-party listings of a 1M variant of this model are NOT official and are deliberately not reflected here.
